dynamic_line.no: Only those who bear my mark will prove themselves worthy of my skills.
dynamic_line.yes: You bear my mark, meaning I believe you have potential to learn to truly listen to the Song.  Yes, I will lend my skills to you, for now.

responses.text: I am glad to hear it.  Let's go then.
That's good, but I need to go at it alone right now.  <end_talking_later>
